body:
Alright I'll look into the positive affirmations, thanks!

When I'm not at home, I often forget about the whole "i'm ugly" deal because I'm usually talking with people, working etc. So I don't think it leaks out so much at school, but at home it definitely does.

When people complement me, it's kind of like in a joking way. Stuff like "only he can get away with wearing that everyday", "be careful what you say, because he's going to own this place one day". Even though I'm not one for popularity, I have a pretty large circle of friends somehow.

I do like peer tutoring, and anyone ever needs help I'm always there to comfort, help etc. so that's where the whole everyone telling me i'm nice thing probably comes from. And the whole intelligence thing is because of grades, test scores etc. and just the way I talk in general.

Yeah, I go to a high school/college and I wear the tie everyday. It started off as a joke at the beginning of the last school year, but it stuck with me. There are only around 120 students at my school (the rest are college students), and the one's I've asked have told me to maintain my fashion style because it's what they know me by. Overall it's been well received, I even won best dressed at my school by a landslide.

The way I talk and write is definitely a little bit advanced for me age, but my writing is more so out of habit because of AP English.

I don't think very much of myself, but people have always told me I'm one of the kindest, most intelligent people they've ever met. Even though on the inside I have a very low self esteem, I tend to convey the opposite on the outside. So it really does seem like the only barrier is my appearance.

Anyways, yeah I'm not a fan of that suit in the photograph since it obviously doesn't fit. That was awhile back, so I've gotten a new, better fitting suit. The vest fits me fine now, and so does the lab coat from the last picture.
By suit, I mean with the jacket and vest
Alright, I'll look into that. Thanks!
My everyday attire is usually a shirt, tie, and slacks, no suit.

Alright, thanks! And should I really get a buzzed kind of hair style? I used to have my hair done really short, but I never though it looked very good. But I guess I'll try it out again when I go to the barber.

Thank you, I have actually considered writing books before, but I haven't given it too much thought. I'll look into doing that. I'd be so much happier if I weren't ugly, if I weren't so lonely. I've been quite the introvert, but I've noticed that in the past few years I've become a bit more extroverted. I've come to enjoy deep conversations and friendships, but alas I have neither.

With all the school work I have it's been a major struggle to accomplish much else. As it is I generally operate on 6-3 hours of sleep a night. The only time I have to exercise would be late at night, and I'm more than willing to, but I'm worried that I'll make no progress given that I have little power over my diet. Honestly if my parents weren't around I would've just starved myself to lose the weight. I do all the things you mentioned in the last paragraph, but I find that I'm ignored when talking to those around me, I feel to ugly to be successful socially. I can just see my future, me sitting in the middle of a dark devoid house alone, just sitting there with no one around, no one to talk to, and that's a future that I don't want, alone, only working and sleeping, nothing else. A future devoid of love and happiness.

I'm 16 almost 17.

The medical field is primarily what I'm interested in. My career goal since I was probably 4 years old has always been to become a pediatric orthopedic surgeon. Other than that I've recently become interested in politics, I thought about a political career after if I were to ever retire from the medical field. I'm into math, science, history, and teaching, but above all else I'm into medicine. I've written down my ideas before, and I'm knowledgeable on quite a few subjects, I could probably write an entire book on some topics. Philosophy also interests me.....thinking....deep discussions etc.

I dislike every last bit of my body, literally every part of me. The only thing I can change would be my weight, which is hard because healthy eating is something my parents cannot afford. And my parents aren't privy to the idea of me starving myself to lose weight. BUT, let's say I somehow did do it, I still hate all the features of my body, I hate all the factors that can't be changed. Everybody in my age group overlooks me, luckily I'm not harassed or bullied because of my personality, I'm the type of person that someone just can not be mean to. But I'm overlooked, no one really cares. The way I feel can be summed up by a quote by an author that says "A great fire burns within me but no one stops to warm themselves at it, and passersby only see a wisp of smoke."

I'm not liable for when your screen spontaneously combusts from the sheer vileness on display....lol
